data.define: Short for "not gonna lie", before an honest opinion.

misuse.text: Don't use 'ngl' in a job application.

native.tip: “ngl” = jujur aja. Contoh: “Ngl, I loved that movie.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “ngl”?
“ngl” = jujur aja.
Contoh: “Ngl, I loved that movie.” (Ngl, aku suka film itu.)
